_comment: Curated examples of CPT code pairs that are often mutually exclusive or represent unbundling. HEURISTIC ONLY — these examples flag a suspicion for human/provider review, never a billing determination. Code meanings are illustrative, not authoritative.

pairs.note: Only the single highest applicable office-visit level should typically be billed for one encounter.
Only one emergency-department visit level per ED encounter.
93000 is the global ECG code; 93005 (tracing only) may be a component that should not be billed separately.
80053 (comprehensive metabolic panel) includes the components of 80048 (basic metabolic panel).
Two-view chest X-ray vs single-view chest X-ray for the same session.
Total knee arthroplasty vs partial (unicompartmental) knee arthroplasty — mutually exclusive procedures.
